name: Dynamic Pricing for Ecommerce Products
author: Digital Web Tutor

sections.description:
Dynamic Pricing for Ecommerce Products is a simple yet powerful WooCommerce plugin that lets you create flexible pricing rules based on product quantities. Perfect for store owners who want to offer bulk pricing, quantity discounts, or custom pricing tiers to encourage larger purchases and increase sales.

Why Use Dynamic Pricing for WooCommerce?

  • Boost Sales with Bulk Discounts: Set special prices for specific quantities to incentivize customers to buy more.
  • Flexible Pricing Rules: Define custom prices for different quantities and set additional per-item pricing or flat rates for larger orders.
  • Easy to Set Up: Add pricing rules directly from the product edit page in WooCommerce—no coding required.
  • Seamless Integration: Works perfectly with WooCommerce, ensuring a smooth experience for you and your customers.

Pricing Example

  • Single Quantity (Base Price): $150 per piece.
  • 2 Quantities: Set a discounted total, e.g., 2 items for $280 (save $20).
  • 5 Quantities: Offer a bigger discount, e.g., 5 items for $650 (save $100).
  • Flat Rate After a Threshold: For quantities beyond 5, set a flat rate of $120 per additional item (e.g., 6 items would be $650 + $120 = $770).

Whether you’re running a small shop or a large ecommerce store, this plugin helps you create WooCommerce pricing strategies that drive revenue. Offer quantity discounts, bulk pricing, or custom pricing tiers with ease.

How It Works

  1. Enable dynamic pricing for any WooCommerce product.
  2. Set quantity-price pairs (e.g., 2 items for $280, 5 items for $650).
  3. Define an additional flat rate per item for quantities beyond your set tiers (e.g., $120 per item after 5 items).
  4. Watch your customers enjoy automatic discounts in the cart!

This plugin is ideal for businesses looking to implement dynamic pricing, bulk pricing, or quantity discounts in their WooCommerce store.

Support the Plugin

If you find this plugin helpful, please consider supporting its development with a donation at Digital Web Tutor. Your support helps keep this plugin free and updated! You can also visit the plugin page at wordpress.org/plugins/dynamic-pricing-for-ecommerce-products/ to leave a review or get support.
sections.installation:
1. Download and Install:

    • Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
    • Search for “Dynamic Pricing for Ecommerce Products”.
    • Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”.

  2. Manual Installation:

    • Download the plugin ZIP file from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
    • In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
    • Upload the ZIP file and click “Install Now”, then “Activate”.

  3. Set Up Dynamic Pricing:

    • Edit any WooCommerce product.
    • Go to the “Dynamic Pricing” tab in the product data section.
    • Enable dynamic pricing and set your quantity-price pairs and additional per-item pricing.
    • Save the product and test the pricing on your store.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with all WooCommerce products?

Yes, the plugin works with simple WooCommerce products. Support for variable products may be added in future updates.

Can I set different pricing rules for each product?

Absolutely! You can enable dynamic pricing for individual products and set custom quantity-price pairs for each one.

Is this plugin compatible with other WooCommerce extensions?

Yes, it’s designed to work seamlessly with WooCommerce. If you encounter compatibility issues with other extensions, please let us know!

How do I get support?

For support, please visit Digital Web Tutor or post in the plugin’s support forum on WordPress.org.
